name: Spool
description: Two flanges and the barrel wound between them.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 8%, #000 8% 20%, transparent 20%), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 80%, #000 80% 92%, transparent 92%), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 42%, #000 42% 58%, transparent 58%); mask: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 8%, #000 8% 20%, transparent 20%), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 80%, #000 80% 92%, transparent 92%), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 42%, #000 42% 58%, transparent 58%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
